items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: "A call for every Joey and Jane, I go dancing in the rain,"

ctx.x: Well anyhow, Ed Arnold was doing six nights, you know, six days, you see. And we had a Monday -- a Monday but the rent was going on, see. And I'm tickled about it, see, because it was such a happy show. It was family story show, "Curley Mc Dimple." And they was selling records, you know. And the way she sang, you know -- the baby singing, you know. And she sang, and she was going down -- way down in a bass voice, you see.

I was doing a number -- a song in the show called "Whenever raindrops started to fall, here in my heart I hear the call. A call for every Joey and Jane, I go dancing in the rain," you see. So, that's what we did.
But so, Mr. Dardo, he says, say, you know, I got a Monday here --
